title: Resetting your password
body: Use the account settings page, choose reset password, and follow the emailed link within 30 minutes.

title: Refund policy
body: Refunds are issued within 5 business days for charges made in the last 30 days. Contact billing with the order id.

title: API rate limits
body: The ticket API allows 100 requests per minute per key. Exceeding the limit returns 429 with a retry-after header.
